g.text: Fig. 3. Uncertainty. (a, b) 95 % interval coverage against half-width in nested cluster CV (ML: quantile of inner out-of-fold residuals; meta-models:
model-based; equal stacks: mean member half-width; learned stacks: inner out-of-fold residuals). (c) The CI of the pooled mean is narrow, the
prediction interval for a new study is wide: the average effect is well estimated, the effect in a new study is not. [V5 (2026-11-20)]
